checks.why: request.getfixturevalue("name") in a test's body requests that fixture, which reaches the test (#1514)
the fixture's own callee reaches the test through the by-name request too
a getfixturevalue call in a helper that is no test requests nothing, and a fixture's name in some other call is no request (near miss for #1514)
getfixturevalue(<param>) requests each fixture the test's parametrize lists for that one argument (#1514)
the other listed value is requested too, and reaches the test through its fixture
a parametrized string the test only uses as a value requests no fixture, though it is a fixture's name (control)
with several argument names, getfixturevalue(<param>) requests the value in that argument's own column of each row
a fixture's name in another column of the same rows is only a value, not a request (near miss for the column rule)
argnames written as a list: the column is the name's place in the list
